units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> (expl. <cite ref="A01999"><he>אמון</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 8:30">Prov. VIII, 30</cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:6">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>למלך שמסר את בנו לפ׳ וכ׳</he> like the case of a king that gave his son in charge of a governor, who led him to excesses. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 101ᵇ <he>אמר פִּידָגוֹגוֹ וכ׳</he> said his tutor, let him go to school; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּדָגוֹגִין</he>, <cite ref="Q00107"><he>פִּידָ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:2">Num. R. s. 1</cite>, beg. <he>ולא העמדתי לכם שלשה פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="L00167"><he>להם</he></cite>) and did I not assign to you three governors: Moses, Aaron, and Miriam? (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:6">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>שלוחין</he>).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:11">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; a. e.
